title: Shanghai Targets 8,000 Humanoid Robots in Factories by 2028
key_facts: Shanghai set a goal of deploying 8,000 humanoid robots in factories by 2028, according to an action plan for next-generation smart manufacturing launched at the opening of the 26th China International Industry Fair, as reported by Chinese media including The Paper on 13 Oct 2026.
The plan has four projects and 19 core tasks and also targets 500 advanced smart factories, more than 2,000 AI use cases in manufacturing and 300 high-level AI agents by 2028.
It aims for industrial robot density of about 600 units per 10,000 people, a 200 billion yuan smart manufacturing equipment industry and a 100 billion yuan system integration industry.
Shanghai already operates 30 intelligent factories, the most of any Chinese city.
Wang Xingxing, chairman of robot maker Unitree, said the tipping point for physical AI could arrive within one to two years.
UBTECH has started operating a humanoid plant in Liuzhou with annual capacity of 10,000 units, according to Global Times.
quote_evidence: Shanghai authorities have set a goal of deploying 8,000 humanoid robots in factories by 2028, as competition among countries and cities to become artificial intelligence hubs intensifies.
It also said it will raise industrial robot density to about 600 units per 10,000 people and push to put 8,000 humanoid robots into factories.
Wang Xingxing, chairman of robot maker Unitree, said the tipping point for physical AI could arrive within one to two years.
why_it_matters_hint: China's biggest industrial city sets a numeric target for humanoids in factories, a goal and not a result.
event_date: Plan launched at the fair's opening ceremony (the article places it the day before The Paper's report of 13 Oct 2026, so 12 or 13 Oct 2026); Seoul Economic Daily report 14 Oct 2026.
notes: Seoul Economic Daily article, AI-translated from Korean (as the page states), citing Chinese media including The Paper. The exact day of the opening ceremony is ambiguous in the text (12 or 13 Oct 2026), so the score is not lowered.
